instruction_text: Translate the Chinese development-control clause into English. Retain all numerical limits, the requirement for a landscaped setback, and the stated prohibitions on its use.
clause_type: Development restrictions and site design controls
source_text: 在轻工业分区内，任何新建或扩建建筑的地块覆盖率不得超过地块面积的55%，建筑高度不得超过18米。沿公共道路的地块边界应设置不少于6米宽的绿化退界，且不得用于停车或装卸。
target_text: Within the light industrial zone, the site coverage of any new or extended building must not exceed 55% of the site area, and building height must not exceed 18 metres. A landscaped setback at least 6 metres wide must be provided along the site boundary adjoining a public road; it must not be used for parking or loading and unloading.
aligned_terminology: 轻工业分区 — light industrial zone; 地块覆盖率 — site coverage; 绿化退界 — landscaped setback; 装卸 — loading and unloading
